room_rent.note: Optional add-on 'Any Room Upgrade' available; Classic plan also has 'Premium Management' option capping at ₹3,000/day

icu.note: ICU covered up to Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule

copayment.note: Applicable on all claims irrespective of age; insured can opt to reduce to 0% or 10%, or increase to 30%, subject to underwriting. Additional zonal co-pay of 10–20% may apply if treatment taken in higher zone.

sub_limits.display: Donor complications capped at 25% of SI (max ₹2L); multifocal lenses & femto laser for cataract excluded
sub_limits.note: Donor complication expenses capped at 25% of SI subject to max ₹2 Lacs over and above base SI; multifocal/toric lenses and femto laser-assisted cataract surgery excluded; otherwise no broad disease sub-limits

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 24 months; reducible to 90 days via optional paid add-on (D.III.4)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, hernia, knee replacement, varicose veins, stones, BPH, piles, sinusitis, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl. 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of Base SI added per completed claim-free or claim year; accumulates up to 100% of Base SI; accrues regardless of claims

restoration.note: Elite plan: unlimited restoration inbuilt for related and unrelated illnesses. Classic plan: restoration is an optional paid add-on. Restoration does not apply to first claim in policy year; not carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Classic: 30 days pre-hospitalisation; Elite: 60 days pre-hospitalisation; both up to Sum Insured

post_hosp.note: Classic: 60 days post-hospitalisation; Elite: 90 days post-hospitalisation; both up to Sum Insured

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI
day_care.note: All medically necessary day-care treatments covered; OPD not included

domiciliary.note: Minimum 3 consecutive days treatment required; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.); pre/post 30 days each

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospital covered; pleasure/rejuvenation treatments excluded

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation, screening (once/year for successful transplant), and complications up to 30 days post-discharge covered; complications capped at 25% of SI max ₹2L over and above base SI

ambulance.display: Covered up to SI (road); Air ambulance up to ₹10L (Elite)
ambulance.note: Road ambulance: reasonable & customary charges up to SI. Air ambulance: Elite plan only, up to SI subject to max ₹10 Lacs over and above base SI; Classic plan does not include air ambulance

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern/advanced treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to Sum Insured

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items (NME) covered up to SI via optional ManipalCigna Health 360-Shield add-on; not inbuilt in base plan

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium payment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; continuity credits for PED, waiting periods, moratorium transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD, treatment outside India, dental (unless accident+24h hosp), sleep apnea devices (CPAP), external congenital anomaly, multifocal lenses/femto laser cataract, off-label drug use

optional_riders.display: Any Room Upgrade, Premium Management (Classic), Restoration add-on (Classic), PED waiting reduction to 90 days, Deductible (₹10K–₹5L), Health 360-Shield (NME/DME), Health 360-OPD
